title: A legal requirement is not a selling point
notes: Dewlane Woche 1 (Produktion 01.11.2026), Vorlage 1.0, Qualitätsmaßstab Testvideo Q1. Thema aus dem Kalender: Eine Aussage, die nur das gesetzlich Vorgeschriebene wiederholt, darf nicht als besonderer Vorzug des Produkts erscheinen. beats.spoken: In the EU, a legal requirement can't be advertised as a special advantage.

It's in Regulation 655 from 2013, under legal compliance. Claims that suggest a specific benefit, when that benefit is just meeting minimum legal requirements, are not allowed. Claiming that a product has been approved by an authority isn't allowed either.

rows.text: sold as an advantage: not allowed

beats.spoken: Honesty works the same way. A claim must not give a product unique properties if similar products have the same properties. And if an effect depends on conditions, like using other products too, that has to be stated clearly.

What could that look like? An example, for illustration: every cream in the EU has to carry an ingredient list and be safe. Present exactly that as a special plus, and you're selling a duty as an extra.

items.title: Sold as a plus?
items.sub: then it's a duty as an extra

beats.spoken: The principle behind it is Article 20 of the EU cosmetics regulation: advertising must not imply characteristics or functions a product doesn't have.
For you, that means: for every plus point, ask whether it applies to all cosmetics anyway. If it does, it's no reason to pick this particular product.
